blurb: Ballast Point Brewing offers fresh beer and great food at their tasting rooms in San Diego, Anaheim, and Long Beach. They also sell apparel, headwear, and accessories inspired by their beers and West Coast roots. The brewery is known for pioneering West Coast IPA with Sculpin and building tasting rooms rooted in coastal culture.
